description: This source file defines the PaymentModule interface, which declares methods for payment transaction management such as initialization, authorization, capture, refund, and configuration validation within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: PaymentModule
classes.description: An interface defining payment transaction operations such as init, authorize, capture, refund, and configuration validation for payment systems.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the payment module configuration for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new payment transaction, returning a Transaction object, commonly used for initializing a payment process such as PayPal express checkout.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Authorizes a payment based on the provided customer, items, and amount, returning a Transaction object.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction linked to an order.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs both authorization and capture in a single step for a set of shopping cart items.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a given transaction, either partial or full.
